statements.general: I, the undersigned, as the child's guardian, consent to the doctor examining and treating the child and carrying out the tests they need at this clinic. I may ask the doctor about any procedure before it is carried out, and I may withdraw this consent at any time without it affecting the child's right to receive care.
statements.examination: I consent to the doctor examining the child clinically, including physical examination and measurement of vital signs. It has been explained to me that the examination may require uncovering parts of the child's body, and that this is done in my presence.
statements.procedure: The doctor has explained to me the nature of the procedure proposed for the child and its purpose, what is expected of it, the possible risks, the available alternatives, and what may follow from not carrying it out. I have had the opportunity to ask questions and they were answered, and I consent to it being performed.
statements.vaccination: I have been told the name of the vaccine and the dose to be given to the child and its benefits, the common effects after it (a mild fever or soreness at the injection site), and the symptoms that mean returning to the clinic. I have had the chance to ask, and I consent to the vaccine being given.
statements.anesthesia: It has been explained to me what type of anaesthesia is planned for the child, its purpose and its possible risks, and I have told the doctor of any allergy the child has, any medicines they take, and any previous experience of anaesthesia. I consent to the anaesthesia and to the measures needed to keep the child safe during it.
statements.data_privacy: I consent to the clinic keeping the child's medical data in their file and using it to follow up their treatment and to issue the reports and invoices required. This data is not shared with any outside party except with my consent or where the law requires it. I have the right to see the file and to ask for anything in it to be corrected.
statements.photography: I consent to the child's condition being photographed or filmed for the medical purpose explained to me, and to it being kept in the child's file. It is not used for teaching or publication except with separate written consent and after removing anything identifying the child. I may withdraw this consent at any time, and that applies to anything not yet published.
statements.admission: I, the undersigned, as the child's guardian, agree to the child being admitted to the hospital, and to their examination, treatment and the tests they need during the stay. I have read the rules of the stay, or had them read to me, and was given the chance to ask and have my questions answered. Any procedure or anaesthetic needs a separate consent, asked of me at the time. I may ask for the child to leave at any time, signing a statement that it is against advice if the doctor advises otherwise.

backups.title: Backups
backups.hint: A safe, consistent snapshot of the database (even while running). Take one before any big change and download copies off this machine regularly.
backups.none: No backups yet — create the first one now.
backups.restored: Restored successfully — an automatic snapshot was taken first ({pre})
backups.restore_prompt: Restoring replaces the entire current database (an automatic snapshot is taken first). Type RESTORE to confirm:
backups.auto_hint: The automatic backup is taken on the first use of the system after the chosen hour. Each kind has its own schedule and its own number of copies to keep, so the small daily snapshots cannot push the full archives off the end. Retention applies to automatic backups only — manual ones are never deleted automatically. When both fall due on the same day only the full one is taken, because it covers the other. A backup is also taken before every database upgrade.
backups.upload_hint: Upload a backup file (.db) from your device — it is checked to be a healthy database belonging to this program, then appears in the list and can be restored with the same safe restore flow.
backups.upload_not_sqlite: The file is not a valid SQLite database.
backups.upload_too_big: The file exceeds the allowed size.
backups.upload_corrupt: The file is corrupt — integrity check failed.
backups.upload_wrong_app: The file is a database but does not belong to this program.
backups.uploaded: Uploaded: {name} — you can restore from it in the list.
backups.include_files_hint: Pictures are not inside the database — the file is on disk and the database only holds its name. Without this, a restore brings every record back with a broken image beside it: patient and staff photos, the clinic logo, doctors' signatures and stamps, attached documents. This setting covers the safety snapshots taken automatically before a restore or an upgrade — manual and scheduled backups now each state their own kind.
backups.no_files_hint: This snapshot was taken as the database alone, so it carries no pictures.
backups.pwd_hint: New snapshots are written as AES-256 ZIP — 7-Zip and any other archiver opens them with the passphrase.
backups.pwd_warn: A backup holds every patient the clinic has seen: names, phone numbers, diagnoses, photographs. On a flash drive or sent over WhatsApp, whoever picks it up reads all of it. Set a passphrase.
backups.pwd_lost: There is no recovery for this passphrase. Lose it and the backups made with it are gone — one we could recover is one an intruder could recover.
backups.pwd_scope: Applies to new snapshots only. Existing ones still need the passphrase they were made with; the program asks for it when restoring.
backups.pwd_set: Backup passphrase saved. New snapshots will be encrypted.
backups.pwd_cleared: Backup passphrase removed. New snapshots will be unencrypted.
backups.pwd_mismatch: The two entries do not match.
backups.pwd_failed: Could not write to clinic.env — check the file is not read-only.
backups.bad_password: Wrong passphrase — this backup was made with a different one.
backups.newer_refused: This backup was taken by a newer version of the program than the one installed here, so it was not restored. Update first (update.bat), then restore it.
backups.upgraded_from: The backup was from version {version} — the database shape was brought forward after restoring.
backups.kind_db_hint: Small and quick — records and money, without the pictures. This is the one to take daily.

mine.title: My clinic
mine.newold_hint: New means the child's first-ever visit to the clinic falls in this window — not their first with you.
mine.account_note: These three are over all time, not the window above: a balance is what has happened since the beginning. Earned is your share on every invoice line plus the fee on every dose you gave here; paid is money recorded as handed to you.
mine.nothing_billed: Nothing was billed in this window.

cardio.gradient_over: Above the {n} mmHg usually taken as the threshold for looking further at the aorta. The program has subtracted two readings — it has not made a diagnosis.
cardio.arms_differ: The arms differ by {n} mmHg, which is itself worth a second look.
cardio.screen_pass: Passes the newborn screen: ≥95% in one limb and no more than 3% between them.
cardio.screen_repeat: Repeat in one hour. Either both readings are 90–94%, or they are more than 3% apart. Three of these counts as a fail.
cardio.screen_fail: Fails the newborn screen — under 90%. This needs assessment now, not a repeat.
cardio.screen_rule: Newborn CCHD screening rule: pass at ≥95% with ≤3% between limbs, fail under 90%, otherwise repeat.
cardio.not_a_newborn: The difference is shown; the newborn screening result is not, because that algorithm is for babies in their first days and this child is past it.

shiftsum.title: Shifts — by person and by till
shiftsum.sub: Every shift in the window, added up two ways. Read-only: nothing here closes a shift or writes a difference off.
shiftsum.net_note: Net {v} across {n} shift(s) that came out wrong. Short and over are shown apart on purpose: 200 over one day and 200 short the next nets to nothing and is not nothing.
shiftsum.shared_title: {n} till(s) were worked by more than one person
shiftsum.shared_note: Where one drawer is worked by two people, "who is short" and "which drawer is short" stop being the same question. If the money is handed over at the end of every shift rather than left in the drawer, they never should have been.
shiftsum.cash_only_note: The difference is a cash difference. Card takings never sit in a drawer and are never counted, so a till that mostly takes cards shows small differences against large collections.
shiftsum.nothing: No shifts were opened in this window.

payouts.pick_first: Pick a doctor from the list above.
payouts.nothing: No doctor has earned anything yet, and nothing has been paid out.

payouts.need_amount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
payouts.collected_note: Collected means the money actually arrived — from the family at the desk, or from a payer on a claim that was paid. Earned above still means everything billed.

theatre.identity_role_none_present: Nobody from the family was present

theatre.postpone_hint: Postponing is not cancelling: this case is closed and booked again on the day you choose, and the two stay linked.
theatre.postpone_needs_date: Give the day this case was moved to.
theatre.postpone_not_open: This case is not open, so it cannot be moved.

theatre.privilege_acknowledged_ok: The reason is recorded, and the gap stays visible
theatre.implants_ready: All of it is in the room

theatre.recall_none: No child has an implant matching that.
theatre.equipment: What this case needs in the room
theatre.equipment_needed: Does this case need anything the room does not always have?
theatre.equipment_checking: Some items nobody has looked at
theatre.equipment_needs_answer: Answer whether this case needs anything extra. Leaving it blank means nobody asked, which is not the same as "the room has everything".
theatre.equip_add: Add something the list does not carry
theatre.workup: What this case is waiting on
theatre.precautions_today: Today's cases needing more than the usual
theatre.precautions_need_answer: Tick at least one. "Standard precautions only" is a valid answer — but ticking nothing means nobody asked, which is a different thing.
theatre.precaution_note: What for (the organism, or the test still pending)
theatre.workup_needed: Does this case wait on investigations?
theatre.workup_needs_answer: Answer whether this case waits on investigations. Leaving it blank means nobody asked, which is not the same as "waiting on nothing".
theatre.workup_pick: Tick the orders this case waits on. Unticking one returns it to the child's file as an ordinary order — it is never deleted.
theatre.workup_no_orders: This child has no investigation orders on file.
theatre.workup_read_only: Read from the imaging attached to this case — not a box to tick
theatre.item_patient_site_procedure: Name, site and procedure confirmed aloud
theatre.item_procedure_recorded: The procedure actually done is recorded
theatre.item_recovery_concerns: What recovery needs to watch for
theatre.item_team_introduced: Team introduced by name and role
theatre.locked_billed: This operation has been charged, so what its bill was built from is locked
theatre.mine_none: You have no cases on this day.
theatre.not_priced: This operation has no service on it, so it is never charged — pick one if it should be
theatre.not_signed_in: Cannot start: the “before anaesthesia” stop has not been signed
theatre.not_started: This case has not gone in yet
theatre.op_note_hint: This is the page the next doctor reads before touching this child again
theatre.person_none: This person has no cases on this day.
theatre.plan_events: Any unusual event and its management
theatre.plan_fluids: Fluid management — deficit, maintenance, balance, fluids/blood
theatre.plan_induction: Induction technique — drugs, doses, route and time
theatre.plan_none: No anaesthesia plan recorded for this case.
theatre.pre_induction_hint: A second assessment, distinct from the one made days ahead — made in the anaesthetic room immediately before induction. The checklist's anaesthetic item is read from it.
theatre.pre_induction_stale: The assessment is not from the day of the operation
theatre.preop_hint: Cases nobody has looked at yet. Reviewed before the day, not with the child in the room.
theatre.preop_none: No case is waiting for a review.
theatre.review_blocks: A review says this case is not fit — read it before starting
theatre.review_needs_reason: Write the reason or the condition — “not fit” with nothing after it stops a list and tells the next person nothing
theatre.room_empty: Nothing booked in this room today
theatre.rooms_sub: The rooms themselves: added and taken out of use from here, not from a release
theatre.sign_out_missing: The “before leaving the room” stop has not been signed
theatre.site_needs_side: A side is required — "not applicable" is a correct answer when the procedure has none.
theatre.site_read_only: This item is read from the recorded site marking — it cannot be ticked by hand.
theatre.stop_when_sign_in: With the child awake and the family there
theatre.sub: The theatre list, and the checklist that stands in front of the knife

theatre.privilege_warn_supervised: Privileged under supervision — this case needs a named accountable supervisor.
theatre.privilege_warn_outside: Outside this surgeon's recorded privileges. The booking goes through, and the operation screen asks for the reason in writing.
theatre.gas_privilege_warn_supervised: This anaesthetist holds this kind under supervision — the operation screen names the accountable supervisor.
theatre.gas_privilege_warn_outside: This kind of anaesthetic is outside the anaesthetist's recorded privileges. The booking goes through, and the operation screen asks for the reason in writing.

lab.sub: The rack: what was asked for and has no answer yet
lab.tests_sub: What the lab runs, and what each one is charged as
lab.no_tests: No tests on the list yet
lab.nothing_waiting: Nothing waiting — no sample to draw and no result to write
lab.tube_auto: Leave blank and one is written for you
lab.already_resulted: This order already has a result
lab.reading_is_the_doctors: Reading the result and deciding on it is the doctor's — it reaches them in the results inbox and in the child's file, and the curve is drawn from the number on its own.
lab.print_child_labels: Print every label for this child
lab.no_tube: That order has no tube — it is not a lab test.
lab.nothing_to_draw: No samples are waiting to be drawn for this child.
lab.scan_ph: Scan the tube's barcode or type the sample number

pharm.sub: The queue: who is waiting, and what for
pharm.nothing_waiting: Nothing waiting at the counter. A clinic whose families fill their prescriptions outside sees this screen empty for ever, which is right.
pharm.filled_outside: This one is filled outside — nothing leaves our stock and nothing is charged
pharm.already_dispensed: This line has already been handed over
pharm.nothing_to_dispense: No box chosen from the shelf
pharm.queried: The question is recorded and reaches the doctor
pharm.need_note: Write the question — a blank one reads on the doctor's screen as “the pharmacy looked and was happy”

panel_alerts.title: Specialty alert numbers
panel_alerts.sub: When the program warns you — and the number is yours
panel_alerts.why: The survey asked every specialty “when should the program warn you?” and got a hundred and three alerts back. The program says **what it looks at**; the clinic says **when to worry** — it never invents a clinical number. Leave a box empty and that alert stays dormant, exactly as it was.
panel_alerts.none: No alerts the program can answer in the specialties you have.
panel_alerts.saved: Saved, and the alert is now live
panel_alerts.unknown: That alert is not on the list
panel_alerts.need_number: needs a reading the program does not hold
panel_alerts.need_trend: needs a comparison between two visits
panel_alerts.need_cross_check: needs a drug or vaccine knowledge base
panel_alerts.need_doctor: only a person can notice it
panel_alerts.watch_panel: watches a reading from the panel
panel_alerts.watch_age_months: watches the child's age in months
panel_alerts.when_since: and warns after this many months without one
panel_alerts.when_pending: and warns after this many days with no result
panel_alerts.unit_rise_within: rise, in the reading's own unit
panel_alerts.unit_rise: rise, in the reading's own unit
panel_alerts.unit_drop: fall, in the reading's own unit

cpharm.title: Inpatient chart review
cpharm.sub: Whose chart has nobody been through today
cpharm.nobody_in: No children in beds right now.
cpharm.no_drugs: Nothing written on this stay's chart.
cpharm.ask_the_doctor: Ask the doctor about this order
cpharm.asked: Recorded and sent to the doctor — the drug goes on being given
cpharm.nothing_asked: Nothing was asked about this order
cpharm.still_given: The drug goes on being given while this is open — it is a question, not a stop.
cpharm.record_hint: One row saying somebody went through this chart today. Without it, “nobody opened it” and “it was opened and there was nothing to say” look identical.
cpharm.waiting_answer: Waiting on the doctor — they answer from the stay screen
cpharm.supply_sub: What has to be made up for the wards today — child by child
cpharm.all_made_up: Everything is made up. Nothing left for today.
cpharm.prn_by_agreement: When needed — no fixed daily count, supplied by agreement
cpharm.label: On the bag
cpharm.not_running: This order is stopped — it is not supplied

halert.title: High-alert medicines
halert.sub: The medicines this hospital decided to be careful with
halert.why: The medication-management standards are explicit that this list is **the hospital's own** — built from its own use and its own errors and near misses. So nothing is shipped with the software: a paediatric oncology unit and a village clinic do not fear the same molecules, and being wrong about this list is being wrong about the medicines that kill people when they go wrong.
halert.none: The list is empty — nothing marked yet.
halert.precaution_ph: e.g. a second person checks the units before it is given
halert.need_reason: Write the reason — a name on its own tells a night nurse nothing

lasa.title: Look-alike, sound-alike
lasa.sub: The names that get confused — and the list is this hospital's
lasa.why: Which names get mixed up depends on what is on your shelves, whose handwriting is on the chart and what your staff speak. So the list is written here, and the program does not ship one about somebody else's pharmacy.
lasa.precaution_ph: e.g. separate shelves, or tall-man lettering

mederr.title: Medication errors and near misses
mederr.sub: What went wrong and what was caught — and this is what the high-alert list is built from
mederr.no_blame: **There is no field for who made the mistake.** A reporting system with one collects nothing after the first month, which is the oldest finding in patient safety. What is recorded is the stage, the drug and what happened.
mederr.out_A: A circumstance that could cause an error, but none occurred
mederr.out_B: An error occurred and did not reach the child
mederr.out_C: Reached the child and did no harm
mederr.out_D: Reached them and needed extra monitoring to be sure
mederr.out_F: Temporary harm needing or prolonging admission
mederr.recorded: Recorded — thank you; this is what keeps the list current
mederr.need_account: Write what happened, the stage and the outcome
mederr.most_reported: Most reported — these are what the high-alert list is revised against:

duty.already_on: That person is already on this shift on this day.
duty.assign_hint: A duty is written as rostered and is worth nothing until somebody says it happened.
duty.no_rate: No rate set — this duty will be worth nothing.
duty.on_call_rate_hint: Leave blank when it has not been agreed — the program never assumes it equals the presence rate.
duty.own_rate_sub: For an agreed figure that differs from the shift's. An empty box means use the shift's rate.
duty.pick_all: Pick a doctor, a shift and a date.
duty.slot_needs_hours: A shift needs a name, a start and an end.
duty.slots_sub: The names, the hours and the rate are typed here, never shipped
duty.sub: Who is covering, and what it owes — the money that has no invoice behind it
duty.title: Duty rota
duty.waiting: Duties whose day has passed with nobody saying what happened
duty.waiting_sub: Left visible and unpaid, rather than closed by guesswork at month end.

settle.advances_hint: Advances or a mid-month payment — subtracted, or the month is paid twice.
settle.already: Another statement already covers these days — the period would be paid twice.
settle.awaiting_hint: billed and not yet collected — it lands in the statement for the period it arrives in.
settle.close_hint: Once closed the figures never move, even if an invoice is edited afterwards.
settle.draw_hint: A statement opens as a draft: it redraws every time you open it, and freezes on the figures you agreed once you close it.
settle.hint_closed: Frozen at the moment they were agreed.
settle.hint_draft: These are today's figures and may differ tomorrow.
settle.reopen_hint: Only while the money has not gone. After payment the difference lands on the next statement.
settle.sub: The month closed with a doctor — a figure agreed and frozen, not a screen that shifts under them
settle.title: Doctor settlements

svcfix.nothing_billed: This visit was never billed — there is nothing to settle.
svcfix.says_nothing: The bill is unchanged — nothing to do.
svcfix.says_settled: Corrected, and the money is right — nothing to collect or refund.
svcfix.change_service_hint: Pick what the visit actually was; the program says which way the money goes.
svcfix.failed: Could not work it out just now — try again.
svcfix.type_more: There are more — type part of the name.

popup.moved_to_bell: Done. You'll find these in 🔔 notifications and on «My clinic».

packages.hint: A package is a number of sessions for one price, paid once. The service still sells per session exactly as before — both ways work side by side.
packages.name: Package name
packages.need_sessions: A package needs at least two sessions — fewer is just the per-session price.
packages.sold_deactivated: {n} of these have been sold, so it was switched off instead of deleted.
packages.title: Session packages

case_types.hint: Private / hospital / emergency — not a label: the same operation by the same surgeon is a different price and a different fee. Leave it unset and the case prices at the doctor's ordinary rate, exactly as before.
case_types.in_use: {n} cases are of this kind. Move them first.
case_types.rates_hint: Exception prices and fees by kind of case. Leave the price blank for the doctor's ordinary price, and the commission on "as usual" for their ordinary commission. "None" means they are paid nothing on this kind.
case_types.system: A built-in kind cannot be deleted — switch it off or rename it
case_types.title: Case kind

recovery.cannot_discharge: Cannot record a discharge now (the case is unfinished, or already discharged).
recovery.hint: Who is in recovery now, who finished and has not gone home, and who is expected back.
recovery.need_followup_answer: Answer required: is a follow-up needed? Leaving it blank means nobody was asked, which is what this prevents.
recovery.no_instructions: No post-operative instructions are written for this procedure — add them on the service so they go out next time.
recovery.nobody_decided_hint: Should be empty — the discharge screen refuses a blank answer. What lands here was discharged before the question existed.
recovery.not_done_yet: The operation has not finished — there is no recovery to record.
recovery.not_home_hint: Cases that finished with no discharge recorded — including ones nobody marked into recovery at all.
recovery.service_followup_hint: Leave blank when this procedure does not routinely need one. It is a suggestion; the decision is recorded on the case itself.
recovery.title: Recovery & discharge

care.billed_deactivated: This has billed {n} lines, so it was switched off instead of deleted.
care.hint: Hospitals charge it two ways: a daily amount, or a percentage of the bill. Both are available — pick the one your hospital works by, and you can have both. A clinic that defines neither sees no change at all.
care.name: Charge name
care.need_amount: A value above zero is needed — a daily amount or a percentage.
care.sections_hint: Pick the sections the percentage is taken of. Ticking nothing means the whole bill. (Common in Egypt: everything except medicines and stamps.)
care.title: Nursing & medical care

on_call.nobody_at_all: Nobody is on duty right now.
on_call.nobody_on: Rotas with nobody on them right now
on_call.title: Who is on now

basics.hint: The clinic decides what counts as basic. The program only says so — it never stops a booking, a visit or an emergency arrival.
basics.none_required: This clinic asks for no extra details.
basics.title: Basic details on file

imaging.already_reported: That order already has a report.
imaging.not_a_scan: That is a lab order, not a scan — it belongs on the lab screen.
imaging.sub: Scans and tracings: what has been asked for and not done, and what has been done and is waiting for a report.
imaging.sub_diagnostic: Sonar, echo, ECG and EEG — the studies the treating team does itself.

invoice_signoff.note: The query — name the line you are asking about
invoice_signoff.off: This clinic asks for no invoice review. It is set under Settings → Tax invoice.
invoice_signoff.policy_hint: In a hospital a stay's bill is assembled by five different hands — nights, doses, tests, a theatre, and nursing consumables — and none of them sees the whole. The review gates the tax invoice only, never collection.
invoice_signoff.queried: The invoice was sent back with a query.
invoice_signoff.refused: Not done: either this bill is not one that gets reviewed, or the query arrived with nothing written on it.
invoice_signoff.sub: Bills accounts have not been through yet, longest-waiting first.
invoice_signoff.submitted: The invoice was sent to accounts.
invoice_signoff.title: Invoice review

risks.title: Risk assessment
risks.tool_hint: The name of the tool your hospital policy uses. The program records it as written and computes nothing from it.
risks.not_saved: The assessment was not recorded. This risk may be switched off in settings.
risks.policy_sub: Which risks this place looks for, and how often

risks.hours_hint: Empty = your policy names no interval

followup.title: Follow-up instructions
followup.hint: «Come back in two weeks» has a date; «come back at once if…» is the safety net. Nothing is booked from here — this is what the doctor asked for.
followup.instructions_ph: Come back at once if the fever goes above 39 or breathing gets harder
followup.outstanding_sub: A doctor asked for this child again, and nobody has seen them
followup.nobody_waiting: Nobody waiting. Everyone asked back has come, or is not due yet.

care_plan.title: Plan of care
care_plan.none_yet: This child has no plan of care yet.
care_plan.state_stale: The record has moved since the plan was updated
care_plan.from_the_record: Read from the record — nothing to type
care_plan.no_goals: No needs written into this plan yet — and that is the element the standard ends on.
care_plan.sign_hint: Signing means the plan was developed under your supervision.
care_plan.cannot_sign_empty: A plan with no goals cannot be signed — that is the element the standard ends on.

care_plan.bad_progress: That progress is not one of the four the screen can draw.

blood.title: Blood
blood.none_yet: No blood has been requested on this stay.
blood.indication_ph: Why this child needs blood — the blood bank checks the product against it
blood.not_requested: The request was not recorded. The indication is required — without it the blood bank cannot check that the product suits the diagnosis.
blood.not_hung: The bag was not hung — that request was cancelled.

blood.reaction_note: What happened and what was done
blood.cannot_cancel: A request with a bag hung against it cannot be cancelled — the blood went into the child.
blood.watch_every_hint: How often a reading is taken while a bag is running, in minutes. Empty = your policy names no interval, and nothing is ever called overdue.

watch.title: Needs looking at now
watch.subtitle: Across {n} open stay(s)
watch.all_clear: Nothing needs anybody right now — every running bag has readings, and every stay's risks have been assessed.
watch.plans_sub: A doctor wrote a goal with a date; the date has passed and the goal is still open
watch.plans_clear: No goal is past its date.

education.title: Patient and family education
education.none_yet: No education has been recorded for this child yet.
education.not_saved: Not recorded — that topic or method is not one the screen can draw.
education.topic_care_plan: Care plan and its expected outcome
education.topic_medication: Medicines and how to take them
education.detail_ph: In your own words — this is what a surveyor reads
education.state_unchecked: Taught, and nobody checked they understood
education.state_again: Taught and not understood — needs going back
education.all_done: Every required topic taught and understood
education.ticked_not_taught: Ticked as told, with no education recorded

education.board_again_clear: No teaching is recorded as not understood.
education.board_ticked_hint: A «family told» tick on a risk assessment or a blood request, with no education row in the record.
education.board_ticked_clear: Every «family told» tick has teaching recorded behind it.

restraint.expired_hint: Not a missing form — this is restraint without authorisation.
restraint.needs_reason_and_order: Not saved — restraint needs a written reason and a physician order. Both are the standard's own words.

restraint.renewed: Order renewed — the old one is closed.

restraint.unwatched_hint: The interval comes from clinic settings — the standard gives no number.
restraint.watch_minutes: How often somebody checks a restrained child (minutes)

resus.late: Team took more than five minutes

resus.not_saved: Not saved — that outcome is not one this screen can draw.
resus.place_hint: Where — a bed, imaging, a corridor
resus.running_hint: Open for an hour is not an incomplete record — it is one nobody closed.

resus.unanswered: No arrival time recorded for the team

sedation.title: Anaesthesia and sedation record
sedation.sub: Episodes running now, and finished ones with an item missing.
sedation.nobody: No episode is running right now.
sedation.all_complete: Every finished episode has a complete record.
sedation.unwatched: No reading taken for a while

sedation.nobody_today: Nobody today — no operation and no visit.

verbal.open_hint: Still waiting on a read-back or a confirmation — ICD.18 (c) and (d).
verbal.ordered_by_hint: Their name if they are not a user here

verbal.text_hint: Exactly what was said — dose, route and timing
verbal.timeframe: Write a verbal order into the record within (minutes)
verbal.title: Verbal and telephone orders
verbal.waiting_for_other: The confirmation comes from whoever gave the order, not whoever wrote it.

lines.label: Label
lines.title: Catheters and tubes
lines.watch_hint: High-risk and unlabelled, or still in after discharge — CSS.03 (b).

opinions.background_hint: What the consultant needs so they don't start from nothing

opinions.not_saved: Not recorded — a request needs its reason.

opinions.reason_hint: Exactly why this opinion is needed
opinions.responder_hint: Their name if not a user here

opinions.title: Consultations and second opinions

food.meal_times_hint: After sunset · not before the session
food.no_list: The clinic has not written its list of special diets yet — the standard says the list is the hospital's, not the program's.

food.watch_hint: Assessed as needing a special diet with no food ordered — ICD.13 (d).

referrals.waiting_sub: Referrals the child returns from — oldest first.

nursing.not_saved: Not recorded. There is already an initial assessment, or the kind is not valid.
nursing.title: Nursing assessment
nursing.watch_hint: An initial assessment on admission and reassessment on time — the rest the program assembles.

ward_wizard.confirm_unit: Delete this department and everything under it?

closures.title: Closures & maintenance

closures.stranded_title: Children are still in closed places
closures.stranded_hint: Closing is not refused — maintenance happens while a child is there — but somebody has to move them.
closures.stuck: It cannot be reopened on its own: the place above it is still closed.

orders.cannot_confirm: An order is confirmed by a doctor other than the one who entered it.
orders.bad_side: A side is for imaging only, and from the list.
orders.incomplete_sub: Labs and imaging from the last 30 days missing something a request must state.

needs.title: The child's and family's needs and preferences
needs.text_ph: e.g. afraid of needles — mother prefers a female doctor — no porcine gelatin
needs.unasked: Nobody has asked the family about their needs yet.
needs.asked_none: The family was asked and has no special needs.
needs.asked_saved: Recorded that the family was asked ✓
needs.has_some: There are needs on file — end them first if they no longer apply.
needs.need_words: Write the need in the family's words.

access.title: Who can read a child's file
access.sub: Worked out from the permissions themselves, not typed. And each person's confidentiality agreement.
access.future_date: An agreement cannot be recorded with a date that has not come yet.
access.n_unsigned: {n} people read the file with no confidentiality agreement recorded.
access.derived_note: This table asks each user the same question a screen asks when it opens — so it changes on its own when a role or permission changes. The agreement itself is paper in the staff file; this records when it was signed.

retention.title: Retention & destruction
retention.sub: How long each type of document is kept, what has passed its period, and the destruction log (GAHAR IMT.07).
retention.never_deletes: The program deletes no record. This screen only counts what has passed its retention period. Destroying paper or media is done outside the program and recorded in the log below.
retention.n_unset: {n} document type(s) still have no retention period.
retention.past_hint: “Past period” counts records dated before the retention period. Nothing is deleted automatically — the decision is the clinic's.
retention.bad_years: The retention period must be a number from {lo} to {hi} years, or blank.
retention.while_kept: Protecting the record while it is kept
retention.all_signed: Everyone who reads the file has signed the agreement
retention.backups_kept: Keeps the last {db} database and {full} full copies
retention.log_hint: Entries are only ever added — a mistaken line is corrected by a new line saying so.
retention.missing: Date, document type, what was destroyed and method are required.
retention.future: The destruction date cannot be after today.

postop.title: Post-operative plan
postop.hint: GAHAR SAS.12: written by the surgeon before the child leaves theatre. Each save is a new version; earlier versions are kept.
postop.not_by_surgeon: This plan was written by {who}, not the surgeon on the case.
postop.from_previous: Filled from your last plan for the same procedure — check and edit before saving.

specimen.title: Specimens & pathology
specimen.hint: GAHAR SAS.10: every removed tissue takes one of two paths: sent to pathology with a label, or exempted under a line of the hospital's list.
specimen.untracked: The operative report says tissue was removed, and no specimen is recorded
specimen.need_tissue: Write the tissue that was removed.
specimen.labelled: Label (date & time, name & file no., tissue) is on the container
specimen.need_label: Confirm the label is on the container before sending.
specimen.not_exempt: An exemption must come from the hospital's list.
specimen.result_ph: The result as in the report
specimen.bad_result: Result not saved — it must be written, dated after sending and not in the future.
specimen.board_sub: Every tissue still on its way — overdue first (GAHAR SAS.10).
specimen.days_unset: No result time frame is set — until it is, nothing is called overdue.
specimen.untracked_hint: The operative report says tissue was removed (item g), and no specimen is recorded on the case.
specimen.none_to_send: No specimen waiting to be sent.
specimen.exempt_title: Exempt tissues and result time frame
specimen.exempt_hint: The hospital's list. While it is empty nothing is exempt — every specimen is sent. A physician may send any specimen even if it is on the list.
specimen.exempt_empty: The list is empty — no tissue is exempt.
specimen.exempt_add: Add a tissue to the list

preop_assess.title: Pre-operative assessment
preop_assess.hint: GAHAR SAS.03: a complete medical and nursing assessment, results ready, risks written down and acted on — all before the child goes in.
preop_assess.from_postponed: This case was postponed from an earlier booking — the fields come from its assessment. Review and save; the assessment must be repeated after a postponement.
preop_assess.late: Written after the child went in
preop_assess.ph_history: Illnesses · previous surgery and anaesthesia · family bleeding
preop_assess.classes_unset: No risk classification written — the hospital writes it from the pre-op list.
preop_assess.risks_none: No risks needing action (the doctor's decision)
preop_assess.not_saved: Assessment not saved — check the times, weight and class.
preop_assess.classes_hint: The hospital's list — the program chooses no scale. Empty until written.

site_mark.style_unset: No unified mark is written — the hospital writes it on the rooms setup.
site_mark.exempt_case: This procedure is on the hospital's list of procedures exempt from marking.
site_mark.problem_by_surgeon: Marked by someone other than the surgeon
site_mark.problem_in_time: Marked after the call to theatre
site_mark.policy_hint: GAHAR SAS.05: the unified mark and the exempt procedures. The program chooses neither.
site_mark.style_ph: e.g. the surgeon's initials in indelible ink beside the incision
site_mark.no_procedures: No procedures in the services list yet.
site_mark.report_sub: Every case in the period that needed a mark, and which check it missed (GAHAR SAS.05 EOC 5).
site_mark.none_failing: No case missed a check in this period.

implants.title: Implant system
implants.sub: The hospital's list of implants, the events and malfunctions and where they were reported, and the recalls until every family is reached.
implants.report_refused: Not recorded: say who it was reported to, and the time can be neither in the future nor before the event.
implants.event_noted: The event is recorded — it waits to be reported on the implant system screen
implants.event_needs_words: Write what happened. An event is recorded only against an implant that went in.
implants.hours_are: The hospital reaches every family within {n} hours of opening a recall.
implants.hours_unset: The hospital has not set a time frame for reaching families on a recall — the program does not choose it.
implants.close_note: Closing note (required while any family is unreached)
implants.close_needs_note: Some families have not been reached — write why the recall is being closed.
implants.contact_refused: Not recorded — the recall is closed, or this child is not on it.
implants.recall_needs_notice: Write the notice's words, and search on at least one thing.
implants.list_empty: The hospital has not written its list of the implants it uses — the program does not choose it.
implants.no_instructions: No discharge instructions written for this implant.
implants.tell: Discharge instructions given to the family

pacu.title: Recovery room equipment
pacu.sub: Is the recovery room big enough for the theatres, is what it must hold written down, and was it checked? The list is the hospital's; the five headings are the standard's.
pacu.beds_short: The standard asks for at least one recovery bed for each operating room: you have {rooms} rooms and {beds} beds.
pacu.no_room: No recovery room is set up. It is added in the unit and bed layout as a unit of kind “recovery”.
pacu.hours_are: The hospital checks its recovery room every {n} hours.
pacu.hours_unset: The hospital has not set how often the recovery room is checked — the program does not choose it.
pacu.list_empty: This recovery room has no list yet. An administrator writes it under the five headings.
pacu.check_incomplete: Not recorded: every item on the list needs an answer. A check that skipped an item is not a check of the room.
pacu.heading: Heading

support.title: Developer access
support.sub: The developer's account signs in only through a door you open: for a time you choose, for a reason you write, and everything done inside is recorded.
support.rule_door: The account cannot sign in at all unless the door is open for it. The right password with the door shut is recorded.
support.rule_powers: Inside the window it holds the owner's powers: switch a module on, change a setting, fix a list.
support.rule_owner: Five things stay yours alone even with the door open: staff accounts (create, edit, delete), wiping the data, restoring a backup, installing a licence, and this door itself.
support.rule_log: Every page opened and every change saved is recorded here, and “wipe data” does not erase this record. When the time runs out or you close it, the account is signed out on its next click.
support.no_account: No developer account. Make one below and give the developer the password.
support.no_history: The door has never been opened.
support.refused: Not saved — check the fields. The account needs a new username and a password of at least 8 characters; a door cannot be opened twice at once, or without a reason.
support.door_shut: Developer access is closed. The owner of the facility opens it.
support.owner_in_person: This is for the owner in person — it cannot be done through developer access.

ledger_gaps.title: {n} document(s) missing from the journal
ledger_gaps.why: The invoice and the money were recorded, but their journal entry was not written. The profit-and-loss is short by exactly this much until it is.
ledger_gaps.done: {posted} document(s) posted. The journal is complete.
ledger_gaps.partly: {posted} posted, {left} still not — the audit log has the reason.
ledger_gaps.left_why: The expense was deleted from the expenses screen, but its entry stayed in the journal, so the income statement still counts it. This happened before deleting took the entry with it.
ledger_gaps.left_done: {removed} entries removed. The income statement now matches the expenses screen.
ledger_gaps.left_kept: {kept} entries in a closed period were kept: a closed month stays as it was closed. Correct it with a manual entry in an open month.

fhir.export_hint: The child's whole record as a FHIR R4 file — for the hospital or whoever asked. Recorded in the audit log.
fhir.ips_hint: International Patient Summary: problems, allergies, current medicines, immunisations and results — for a hospital meeting the child for the first time. Recorded in the audit log.

arrival.marked: And marked arrived — now in the waiting queue.
arrival.setting: Payment at the desk marks today's booking as arrived
arrival.setting_hint: One step instead of two: a family paying at the desk for today's booking is standing there, so the child joins the waiting queue. A booking for another day, or a child already inside, is left alone. Paying online from home does not mark an arrival.

suggestion_measure.title: How often is the suggestion kept?
suggestion_measure.subtitle: Every request booked: the program had suggested a time, and here is what the desk did with it. These are the numbers to decide by after two months: whether a kind of request can be booked on its own, or a person is needed.
suggestion_measure.link: How often is the suggestion kept?
suggestion_measure.kept_ring: kept the suggestion as it was
suggestion_measure.basis: Of {n} requests booked with a suggestion, since {since}
suggestion_measure.by_type_hint: A type whose suggestion the desk usually keeps is the candidate for booking on its own.
suggestion_measure.by_source: By where the request came from
suggestion_measure.empty: No request has been booked since the measure started.
suggestion_measure.how: Every request booked from the requests screen — by either button — keeps the time the program suggested beside the time that was booked.
suggestion_measure.decision: This only measures; it changes nothing about booking. The decision (stage five of the booking plan) comes after two months of use, by these numbers rather than by opinion.

leave.their_words_ph: e.g. insurance does not cover it

cost_centres.title: Cost centres
cost_centres.desc: Each part of the clinic: what it brought in, what it cost, and what is left.
cost_centres.subtitle: Each part of the clinic with its revenue and its direct costs. Revenue reaches its centre by itself, from where the bill came from; nobody chooses. Shared costs such as rent and electricity stay on a line of their own instead of being spread by a rule nobody agreed.
cost_centres.manage_sub: The parts of the clinic its money is counted by. The program makes them from what the clinic runs: the clinics, each unit (ward, incubators, intensive care), theatres, the laboratory and the pharmacy. Rename one, switch one off, or add your own. None is ever deleted, because the journal points at it.
cost_centres.placed: of revenue placed in a centre
cost_centres.shared_hint: Costs that belong to no one part: rent, electricity, salaries, and doctors paid on account. The clinic chose to keep them on a line of their own.
cost_centres.empty: No journal entries in this period.
cost_centres.how: Every bill posted from today goes to its centre by itself. Any expense you record can be given a centre; with none it is shared.
cost_centres.doctors_hint: The darker start of each bar is the doctors' share of that centre's revenue, read from the bills. It is information, not subtracted here: a doctor's money is posted when it is paid, on account, and that is in the shared costs.
cost_centres.none_placed: No revenue or cost was placed in a centre in this period.
cost_centres.unplaced_hint: Money that came in without a known centre. The program does not guess one.
cost_centres.why_invoice: Bills posted before cost centres began
cost_centres.why_claim: Insurer claim payments (a claim settles many bills at once)
cost_centres.matches: The last figure is the same net profit as in the
cost_centres.field_hint: Choose the centre when the cost is one part's. Leave rent and electricity shared.
cost_centres.service_hint: Leave it on "worked out" unless this service belongs to a centre you added, such as physiotherapy.
cost_centres.add_hint: A centre the program does not make, such as physiotherapy or nutrition. Then point its services at it from the services screen.

booking_requests.title: Booking requests
booking_requests.subtitle: Families who asked for an appointment and have not been answered. A request holds no slot: booking is done from here, on the ordinary booking screen.
booking_requests.search_ph: Search by name or file number
booking_requests.who_hint: If the child has no file: write who asked and their phone; the child is registered when booked.
booking_requests.message_ph: Paste their message or write what they said on the phone
booking_requests.choose_or_register: choose the child or register them below.
booking_requests.need_who: A request needs a child on file, or a name and a phone to call back.
booking_requests.doctor_first: {doctor} has to approve this request first — send it to them from the requests screen.
booking_requests.need_doctor: Choose the doctor to send the request to.
booking_requests.approved: You approved the request — reception will book it.
booking_requests.policy_reception: Reception alone — the doctor leaves it to them
booking_requests.policy_hint: When the doctor approves too, reception sends them the request and it is booked only after their yes — and one doctor's yes is not a yes to book with another.
booking_requests.card_needs_ok: {doctor} has to approve first — send it to them
booking_requests.card_nothing_free: Nothing free in the next {days} days
booking_requests.urgent_strip: requests may be urgent — at the top of the list
booking_requests.urgent_live_b: the request will go to the top of the list, in red
booking_requests.from_chat: Take a booking request from this chat
booking_requests.from_chat_hint: It goes to the requests screen with the same card and the same approval. Nothing is sent to the family.
booking_requests.clinic_policy_hint: The clinic's rule. Each doctor can change it for themselves on their own page, or the admin on the doctor's page.

online_pay.title: Online payment
online_pay.make_link: Make a payment link for the balance ({amount})
online_pay.send_whatsapp: Send it to the family on WhatsApp
online_pay.wa_text:
To pay {amount} on your clinic bill: {link}
Reference: {reference}
online_pay.link_made: Payment link made. The bill is marked paid only when the gateway itself confirms.
online_pay.no_gateway: That payment gateway is not switched on.
online_pay.no_public_address: The program needs an address on the internet for the gateway to reach it — Messages settings → public address.
online_pay.nothing_owed: Nothing is left to pay on this bill.
online_pay.mismatch_note: The gateway confirmed {said} but {asked} was asked — not recorded on the bill. Check it with the gateway.
online_pay.back_not_paid: The payment did not go through
online_pay.back_checking_sub: The clinic will know as soon as the gateway confirms. There is nothing else you need to do.

cmp.title: Complaints and suggestions
cmp.sub: Every complaint gets a number, an owner and follow-up until it is closed. We contact the family within {hours} hours and answer within {days} days — the hospital's policy.
cmp.new_sub: Write what the family said, in their words. They get a number; customer service contacts them within {hours} hours and answers within {days} days.
cmp.description_ph: In their words: what happened, when, and who was there
cmp.wanted_ph: e.g. part refund, an apology, a call from the head of the unit
cmp.anonymous_hint: No name or number is kept and no message is sent. The complaint is still looked into.
cmp.anonymous_paper: you may submit it without your name
cmp.notify: Send them the number on WhatsApp
cmp.need_description: Write what the family said first.
cmp.receipt_promise: Customer service will contact you within {hours} hours and answer within {days} days. Quote this number if you call.
cmp.receipt_thanks: Thank you — it will reach the team.
cmp.blank_intro: Your opinion matters. Write your complaint or suggestion and hand the form to reception or drop it in the box.
cmp.blank_promise: We will contact you within {hours} hours of receiving it and answer within {days} days.
cmp.no_phone: This patient has no phone number.
cmp.invite_failed: Not sent — see the message log.
cmp.search_ph: Number, name, phone or a word from it
cmp.timeframes_hint: The hospital's complaint policy timeframes (PCC.16). A complaint past them is late.
cmp.contact_ph: When you spoke and what they said
cmp.action_ph: What was done so it does not happen again, or for the family
cmp.send_answer: Send it on WhatsApp with a link to rate the answer
cmp.need_answer: Write the words the family will receive.
cmp.waiting_verdict_hint: Two stars or fewer reopens the case by itself. The rating link, if you want to send it yourself:
cmp.serious_hint: Serious: tell the manager, and if a child was harmed file an incident report too.
cmp.msg_complaint_answered: Sent the answer and the rating link
cmp.msg_type_off: Not sent: this message is switched off
cmp.why_rated: The family rated the answer well
cmp.why_unsettled: The family said the answer did not settle it
cmp.public_q: Did this answer settle what bothered you?
cmp.public_rated: Thank you — we have your answer.
cmp.public_working: We are working on it and will reply soon.
cmp.public_link_expired: This link has expired or is not valid. Message us on the same number and we will send a new one.
cmp.public_kind_q: What would you like to tell us?
cmp.public_promise: It goes straight to customer service; we will contact you within {hours} hours.

board_cs.title: Customer-service board
board_cs.sub: Ratings and complaints in one place, for a period and against the one before. Click any number to see the families behind it.
board_cs.trend: The three sides, week by week
board_cs.trend_hint: average stars out of 5 — a week nobody rated is a gap, not a zero
board_cs.nothing_bothered: Nobody picked anything that bothered them in this period.
board_cs.none_left: Nobody left against advice in this period.
board_cs.colours_hint: Colours: green 4.3 and up · amber 3.6–4.2 · red below 3.6. A unit with fewer than {n} answers is not coloured — too few to judge.
board_cs.doctor_hint: A doctor with fewer than {n} answers has no average — two answers are not a verdict.

board_med.desc: Visits and coded diagnoses, inpatient units, emergency and doctors — for any dates, beside the period before.
board_med.title: Medical board
board_med.sub: Counts and illnesses from one date to another, no money. Each figure sits beside the same stretch before it; diagnoses are grouped by code, and each opens the cases behind it.
board_med.top_dx_hint: By code · ICD-10 and ICD-11 each marked · press a diagnosis
board_med.no_coded: No coded diagnoses in this period.
board_med.free_hint: Grouped by the words as written. Its share is a measure of documentation quality too.
board_med.no_free: Every diagnosis in this period was coded.
board_med.rising_hint: Ordered by how many more cases, with no invented line for an "outbreak".
board_med.nothing_rose: No diagnosis rose since the period before.
board_med.ages_hint: Each child once, at their age on their first visit in the period.
board_med.cases_hidden: {n} cases. Names show only to those allowed to open a child's file.
board_med.wards_hint: Mean stay of those who left in the period. Occupancy uses today's beds in service. Readmitted = admitted again within 30 days of leaving, counted from the stays themselves.
board_med.triage_hint: Levels in the words the hospital recorded — the program has no triage scale of its own.
board_med.no_emergency: No emergency attendances in this period.
board_med.doctors_hint: Press any column to sort by it
board_med.doctors_foot: Recorded figures only, no rating. "Back within 7 days" = the same child seen again within a week. "First time" = the child's first visit to the clinic. "Without a code" = diagnoses written as words only.

board_admin.title: Management board
board_admin.desc: Revenue, collections and net per department, what families owe, and the doctors — for any dates, beside the period before.
board_admin.sub: The money and the work of each department at a glance. The figures come from the same entries as the cost-centre report and the income statement, each beside the same stretch before it.
board_admin.departments_hint: Press a department for its detail
board_admin.drawer_hint: The detail by account is in the cost-centre report.
board_admin.shared_line: Shared costs on a line of their own: {amount}
board_admin.no_money: No money entries in this period.
board_admin.watch_overdue: bills overdue by more than 30 days ({amount})
board_admin.watch_shared: shared costs as a share of revenue
board_admin.watch_unplaced: revenue not placed on a department
board_admin.doctors_foot: Recorded figures only, no rating. Revenue and the doctor's share are the bill lines in their name — the same as their statement.

board_mine.title: My patients
board_mine.sub: What a doctor has to do today: who missed a follow-up, which child with a long-standing problem has not been seen, whose vaccine is late. All from what was recorded, with no invented clinical rule.
board_mine.admin_picks: A doctor opens on themselves. An admin can pick any doctor.
board_mine.children_hint: whose last visit was with me
board_mine.followups_hint: I set a follow-up and the child has not come back
board_mine.search_ph: Search by name or file number
board_mine.no_followups: No missed follow-ups among your children.
board_mine.no_followups_q: Nobody by that name among the missed follow-ups.
board_mine.no_chronic: Every child with a long-standing problem was seen in that time.
board_mine.chronic_hint: From the problem list in the child's file. The doctor picks the wait, not the program.
board_mine.more_late: And {n} more on the vaccines-due screen.
board_mine.no_late: No late vaccines among your children.
board_mine.late_hint: The clinic's own vaccines-due sweep — courses started here only.

stay_tests.title: Tests and scans
stay_tests.none: No tests or scans ordered for this stay yet.
stay_tests.ordered: Ordered ✓ — it is on the lab list.
stay_tests.need_name: Write the name of the test or scan.
stay_tests.closed: This stay has ended — nothing new can be ordered on it.
stay_tests.hint: Charged to the stay’s bill once the sample is drawn — not at the clinic desk.

lab_import.unreadable: This file could not be read — check it is a valid Excel file.
lab_import.nothing_found: No column for the test name was found.
lab_import.expired: That reading has expired — upload the sheet again.

lab_import.owed_critical: Critical limits given: {n}. Without them there is no critical-value alert.
lab_import.owed_tat: Expected time given for {n} of {total}. Without it there is no late-result alert.
lab_import.owed_parts: {n} panels do not list their parts — recorded as one result until the laboratory lists them.
lab_import.questions_hint: Each of these is ours and found no twin by name in the sheet. Pick the one it is — it keeps our name and the sheet adds its analytes and ranges — or keep it apart.
lab_import.show_new: Show the new tests to doctors in the search
lab_import.search_ph: Name or abbreviation — CBC, glucose, TSH…
lab_import.ranges_title: What the test measures, and its ranges

lab_import.no_analytes: This test has no analytes yet.
lab_import.no_range: No ranges for this analyte — the laboratory writes them.
lab_import.done_money: {priced} tests took their price from the sheet · {unmatched} consumables are not in the store (left out — add them to the store first).

lab_result.nothing_critical: There is no critical value on this order.
lab_result.read_saved: Recorded that you read the critical value.
lab_result.critical_sub: Results beyond the laboratory's critical limits that no doctor has yet said they read.
lab_result.none_critical: No critical values are waiting to be read.
lab_result.not_read_yet: No doctor has read it yet
lab_result.for_child: Ranges for age {days} days on the day of the sample · {sex}

er_orders.title: Emergency attendance

er_orders.needs_name: Type the drug or pick the service.

er_orders.approved: Approved — the nurse may give it now.
