er_orders.outside_waiting: From outside — waiting for a doctor
er_orders.none_mine: No prescriptions in your name waiting for confirmation.
er_orders.no_tests: No tests or scans ordered for this attendance yet.

inv_list.title: Tests and scans
inv_list.sub: The list a doctor orders from. The clinic's own, like its drugs: add, rename, or hide what you do not use.
inv_list.code_hint: The code the specialty panels find this test by — it stays the same if you rename it.
inv_list.used_hint: Ordered before on a child's file — it can only be hidden, so the old order keeps its name.
inv_list.hidden_instead: This test was ordered before — it was hidden instead of deleted, and the old orders keep its name.

waiting.title: Waiting on:
waiting.approval: Outside prescription waiting for a doctor
waiting.decision: Waiting for the doctor's decision or discharge prescription
waiting.bedless_title: In the department without a bed ({n})
waiting.limit_hint: A child here longer than this is marked red on the live screen. Blank = no limit and no alert.

device_board.sub: Echo, ultrasound, spirometry, ECG and EEG — ordered from the clinic, the emergency or the wards and not yet done. Today's bookings first.
device_board.note_ph: Preparation — e.g. stays up late the night before
device_board.need_when: Pick the day and the time.
device_board.start_label: A new study with no order — file number
device_board.how_orders_come: A study appears here when a doctor orders it from a visit, the emergency or a ward — or start one directly above by file number.
device_board.none_defined: No test is defined as a «device study» in the tests list — the echo, EEG and ultrasound must be defined that way for their orders to arrive here.
device_board.defined_n: {n} tests are defined as device studies.
device_board.filed_elsewhere: {n} open orders for a test tied to a device are filed under radiology or the lab — change its room in the tests list so they arrive here.
device_board.no_devices: No devices recorded yet (echo, ECG, EEG…).
device_board.recent_none: No studies done in these days.

lab_hand.age_ph: As on the sheet: 6-23 months · <1 year · all
lab_hand.source_ph: The reference the laboratory relied on
lab_hand.add_analyte: Add a component to this test
lab_hand.analyte_name: Component name, as the report prints it
lab_hand.analyte_hint: A component another test already measures under the same name is linked, ranges and all — not copied.
lab_hand.remove_analyte_hint: Removed from this test only — old results and the ranges stay.
lab_hand.correct_approved_hint: The approved range keeps judging until this correction is approved — then it replaces that one only.
lab_hand.draft_hint: Saved as a draft: shown beside a result as a reference, and never judges one until approved.
lab_hand.age_unreadable: Could not read the age — write it as on the sheet: 6-23 months, <1 year or all.
lab_hand.need_note: The kind is a note — write the note.
lab_hand.need_figure: Type a low or a high figure.
lab_hand.low_above_high: The low figure must be below the high one.
lab_hand.approved_stays: An approved range is not deleted — correct it, and the correction replaces it when approved.
lab_hand.stop_ph: e.g. analyser broken · reagent out · no longer offered
lab_hand.stopped: Test stopped — it will not be offered on new orders.

lab_stock.title: Price, cost and consumables
lab_stock.cost: Cost of one run to the lab
lab_stock.store_hint: Consumables leave this store when a test's result is entered, once per order. With no store chosen, nothing is taken.
lab_stock.taken_hint: Taken from the lab store when the result is entered — even when the test is not charged separately.
lab_stock.double_taken: This test's price service carries consumables too, which the till takes at billing — they would be taken twice. Keep them in one place.

lab_tpl.test: The test's English name, as the laboratory writes it — one row per component or range.
lab_tpl.name_ar: The Arabic name the doctor will see.
lab_tpl.aliases: Other names to search by, separated by ;
lab_tpl.component: What is measured (for a test with more than one figure). Leave empty for a one-figure test.
lab_tpl.age: The age, e.g. 6-23 months, <1 year or all.
lab_tpl.low: Low limit — from the laboratory's reference only.
lab_tpl.high: High limit — from the laboratory's reference only.
lab_tpl.ref_type: interval for a usual range, cutoff for a guideline figure, note for words.
lab_tpl.critical: The critical value the laboratory set — leave empty if none.
lab_tpl.tat: Expected time in minutes, or 2 hours, or 1-2 days.
lab_tpl.where: In-house if done here, Outsourced if sent out.
lab_tpl.price: The test's price — only given to a test with none; never changes an existing price.
lab_tpl.cost: Cost of one run to the lab.
lab_tpl.consumable: The store item's name or code — one row per item under the same test name.
lab_tpl.consumable_qty: How much of the item one run uses.

lab_steps.name: Name and kind
lab_steps.tat_hint: Time in minutes (30-60), or 2 hours, or 1-2 days.
lab_steps.tat_unreadable: Could not read the time «{v}» — write it in minutes, e.g. 30-60.

approvals.title: Prior approvals
approvals.sub: Approvals the payer must give before certain items — the number travels with the claim. A line that needs one and has none keeps its bill out of the claim until it arrives.
approvals.need_patient_payer: Pick the patient and the payer.
approvals.approved: Approval recorded and linked to {n} lines.
approvals.bad_letter: The file must be a PDF or an image (under 20 MB)
approvals.refunded_to_account: Bill {number} was covered after the approval, and the {amount} the family paid over its share went to its patient account

credit.title: Patient account
credit.give_back_hint: The money leaves the till. Where the clinic requires refund approval, only a manager can hand it back.
credit.off_but_held: The patient account is switched off here, but this patient holds a balance, so it stays shown until it is used or handed back.
credit.top_up: The balance no longer covers what the stay owes — {amount} more is needed
credit.on_account_cash: Cash on patient accounts (in − handed back)
credit.err_closed: This bill was closed by a refund
credit.err_over_owed: More than the bill still owes
credit.err_needs_manager: Handing a balance back needs a manager — refund approval is on
credit.mode_auto: Automatic — on for a hospital or a dental clinic
credit.setting_hint: Money taken before the care (a stay deposit, a dental payment larger than the plan) is held on the patient's account, pays their bills, or is handed back. A patient who holds a balance always sees it, even with the account switched off.
credit.deposit_suggest_hint: A figure the hospital sets for a cash patient on admission to each department, shown on the stay as a suggestion. For an insured member it is set in the contract's terms. Empty = no suggestion.

limits.title: Family share and payer ceilings
limits.hint: What the contract takes back from its cover: a fixed sum the family pays on each bill, and the most the payer pays per bill and per night. Every figure comes from the agreement itself; an empty box means no limit.
limits.ceiling_year: Most the payer pays in a year
limits.year_hint: Per member, over the contract's period (or the calendar year when the contract has no start and end date). Deductible: the first this much of what the contract would cover is the family's.
limits.ceiling_case: Most the payer pays per bill
limits.night_ceiling: Most the payer pays per bed night
limits.terms_bad: Not a valid figure — type a number above zero or leave the box empty
limits.note_room_ceiling: Room difference over the nightly ceiling
limits.policy_wait: Do it and wait for the approval (the family does not pay)
limits.policy_collect: The family pays, refunded to its account when the approval comes
limits.note_awaiting_approval: Awaiting approval — the family pays it until then

renewal.adjust_hint: A raise on one service, a category or everything — or an Excel sheet you edit and upload. You see what would change first, and nothing is saved until you confirm. For a new contract: renew the old one with new dates and adjust here — it starts billing by itself on its first day.
renewal.bad_file: That file is not an Excel sheet we can read
renewal.bad_rows: Rows whose figures cannot be read (skipped): {rows}
renewal.remind_days: Remind this many days before a contract ends
renewal.remind_days_hint: Empty = 30 days. A contract whose renewal is ready is not counted.
renewal.due_lapsed: Ended with no renewal · {n} members with valid cards
renewal.sheet_help_1: Edit only «Contract price», «Cover type» and «Cover value». An empty contract price = the clinic price.
renewal.sheet_help_2: Cover type: percent, amount or not covered. «not covered» with an empty price = the service leaves the contract.
renewal.sheet_help_3: A row is matched by its code, else by the service name exactly. Any service missing from the sheet stays as it is.

lab_critical.called: The call to the doctor was recorded
lab_critical.read_back: The doctor read the value back
lab_critical.mark_title: Mark this result critical (e.g. a positive culture)
lab_critical.err_not_lab: This is not a lab result
lab_critical.err_not_critical: This result is not marked critical
lab_critical.call_late: Told later than the hospital's timeframe
lab_critical.difficulty_ph: No answer, called several times, in theatre…
lab_critical.report_sub: Every critical result in the period: told or not, in time or late, read back, any difficulty, read by a doctor.
lab_critical.timeframe_none: Not set by the hospital yet
lab_critical.none_in_period: No critical results in this period.

radiation.dose_hint: Choose the measure in the unit the machine printed, and type the figure as it is. The program converts between units by their fixed factors only to add and compare — it never estimates a dose.
radiation.before_title: What the child has had before
radiation.before_counts: {n} ionising scans ({recent} in the last {months} months) · contrast {contrast} times
radiation.none_before: No ionising scans or contrast on record for this child.
radiation.this_title: What this scan gave the child
radiation.over_reference: The dose is above the hospital's reference level for this scan — for review
radiation.report_sub: Scans with a dose or contrast recorded in the period — above the reference level and reactions first.
radiation.nothing_in_period: No doses or contrast recorded in this period.
radiation.units_hint: Each machine prints the dose in its own unit. Choose the unit your machines print for each measure: the form offers it first and totals are shown in it. Units convert by their fixed factors (e.g. 1 µGy·m² = 10 mGy·cm²).

er_pay.waiting: Triaged non-urgent and the hospital asks for payment first — the treatment waits for the desk. If the child's state changes, the doctor re-triages urgent.
er_pay.banner_hint: The doctor writes as always; giving and doing wait for the desk. Triaged urgent, the wait lifts at once.
er_pay.cleared: Payment recorded; the treatment goes ahead
er_pay.setting: «Pay first, then it is done» in emergency — for children triaged non-urgent only
er_pay.setting_hint: An urgent or not-yet-triaged child never waits (decree 1063 of 2014: emergency treatment is free for the first 48 hours).
er_pay.free_sub: Attendances triaged urgent in the period, and what was billed in their first 48 hours — to be claimed.
er_pay.free_none: No urgent attendances in this period.

claims_desk.board_hint: Next batch: from the day after the last claimed period up to the contract's cycle day (or today when the contract names none). Figures for the last 12 months.
claims_desk.paid_short: The payer paid {amount} less than it accepted
claims_desk.decide_hint: Write the payer's answer per line: an empty box = accepted in full. Where part or all was refused, write what was accepted and why.
claims_desk.err_not_submitted: The claim must be submitted first
claims_desk.err_bad_amount: Accepted must be between zero and the line's amount
claims_desk.err_need_reason: Every line refused in full or in part needs its reason

lab_reception.note: Note, if accepted though not as it should be
lab_reception.note_ph: Leave blank for a sound sample
lab_reception.rejected: Sample rejected; the order is back to be drawn with a new label.
lab_reception.no_reasons_yet: The lab has not written its rejection reasons yet — on the tests screen.
lab_reception.reasons_hint: Acceptance and rejection criteria are the laboratory's own policy, so the list starts empty and the lab writes it.
lab_reception.no_reasons: No reasons yet. Until there are, the reason is typed.
lab_reception.register_sub: Every rejected sample: the reason, the time, who rejected it and who was told.
lab_reception.none_refused: No rejected samples in this period.
lab_reception.err_not_lab: This is not a lab order.
lab_reception.err_resulted: This order already has its result.
lab_reception.err_not_collected: The sample has not been drawn yet.
lab_reception.err_need_told: Write who was told to redraw.
lab_reception.err_not_a_reason: That reason is not on the list.

lab_release.needs_authorized: Needs someone allowed to release lab results
lab_release.list_sub: Results written and waiting for review and release by an authorized person, oldest first.
lab_release.off_sub: Result release is off in this lab — a result is final once written.
lab_release.setting: Results are verified before they are final
lab_release.setting_hint: The lab's policy. When on, each result stays visible to the doctor marked «not verified yet» until someone allowed to release it does, and the printed report says «preliminary». Critical values are told at once as before.
lab_release.err_not_lab: This is not a lab order.
lab_release.err_no_result: This order has no result yet.
lab_release.err_not_allowed: Releasing results needs the «release lab results» permission.

lab_sendout.title: Samples for a referral lab
lab_sendout.sub: Samples drawn here for a referral laboratory: tick them, choose the laboratory, and the batch gets a number and a manifest to print.
lab_sendout.register_sub: What went where and when it came back, what is late, and the turnaround each laboratory actually kept.
lab_sendout.labs_sub: The laboratories we send to: accreditation as stated, the turnaround in the agreement, the agreement's end date and the last evaluation. The signed agreement itself stays on paper.
lab_sendout.no_labs: No referral laboratories yet — add them on the referral laboratories page.
lab_sendout.nothing_to_send: No drawn samples waiting to be sent.
lab_sendout.recalled: The sample is back as if never sent.
lab_sendout.none_sent: No samples sent in this period.
lab_sendout.err_not_lab: This is not a lab order.
lab_sendout.err_not_collected: The sample is not drawn yet or already has its result.

lab_tat.title: Turnaround
lab_tat.sub: From the sample's collection to its result, judged only against the time the lab wrote on the test.
lab_tat.none_late: No late results in this period.
lab_tat.no_stat: The lab has not given any test a STAT time yet — on the tests screen.
lab_tat.reported_late: Reported after the lab's time — took {n} min.
lab_tat.waiting_late: The sample has passed the time the lab wrote for this test.
lab_tat.told_to: Who was told of the delay
lab_tat.err_not_lab: This is not a lab order.

lab_reagents.title: Reagents
lab_reagents.sub: Each lot: received and inspected, opened, finished. An expired lot is never opened; «expiring soon» means within {n} days.
lab_reagents.not_in_store: Not in the store (type its name)
lab_reagents.name: Name if not in the store
lab_reagents.note_ph: Packaging and cold chain — and why, if rejected
lab_reagents.shelf: On the shelf and in use
lab_reagents.no_store: The lab's store is not chosen yet — on the tests screen.
lab_reagents.none_low: No items under their reorder level.
lab_reagents.err_need_item: Choose the item or type its name.
lab_reagents.err_bad_decision: The inspection result is not understood.
lab_reagents.err_expired_on_arrival: This lot has expired — it cannot be accepted; record it as rejected.
lab_reagents.err_expired: This lot has expired — it cannot be opened.

lab_quality.title: Quality control
lab_quality.sub: Controls run beside patients' samples, read against the target the lab wrote, by the rules the lab chose, and reviewed monthly.
lab_quality.eqa_sub: Proficiency rounds or inter-laboratory comparisons: provider, round, dates, grade, who reviewed it, and the action for anything unacceptable. Kept, never deleted.
lab_quality.open_failures: {n} failed controls with no action written.
lab_quality.target_hint: Mean and SD from the manufacturer's insert for this lot or from the lab's own data — the lab writes them.
lab_quality.rules_hint: The lab's policy. With no rule chosen, whoever ran the control says whether it passed. 1-2s only warns.
lab_quality.rule_2_2s: two in a row beyond 2 SD, same side
lab_quality.rule_R_4s: two in a row beyond 2 SD, opposite sides
lab_quality.rule_4_1s: four in a row beyond 1 SD, same side
lab_quality.rule_10x: ten in a row on one side of the mean
lab_quality.action_ph: What was done when it failed
lab_quality.rules_off: No rules chosen — you judge whether it passed.
lab_quality.run_failed: Control recorded and failed — write the action.
lab_quality.err_need_target: Write the mean and an SD above zero.
lab_quality.err_no_material: This material is not in use.
lab_quality.err_not_allowed: Reviewing needs the «release lab results» permission.

lab_poct.title: Point-of-care testing
lab_poct.sub: Each device, where it is and what it measures, who is trained to use it, and its controls — the reading itself goes on the ward's observation chart.
lab_poct.no_readings: No readings recorded on it yet.
lab_poct.not_trained: Reading saved, but you are not recorded as trained on «{device}».

er_quick.title: Arrived now — before registration
er_quick.name: Name, if known
er_quick.need_age: Write the estimated age (years up to 18, months, or days).
er_quick.list_sub: Children received before they were identified, or with a birth date worked out from an estimated age — completed on the same file, so everything done for the child stays where it is.
er_quick.banner_provisional: Provisional file — the child was received before being identified
er_quick.identity_confirm: The child's identity is confirmed (real name written)
er_quick.dob_confirm: This birth date is the real one, not an estimate

wristband.provisional: Provisional file — identity not confirmed yet
wristband.hint: Two identifiers that are the child's: the name and the file number (and its barcode), with the date of birth — a bed or room number is never one. Sized for a wristband printer; any other printer prints it too.

handover.title: Shift handover
handover.sub: Each department: the handover waiting to be accepted, the last one, and the button to hand over — for doctors and nurses. A child moved to another department waits for that department to accept them.
handover.settings_hint: Choose the tool the hospital uses for each kind. The tool is written onto each handover when it is made, so changing it does not rewrite the old ones. Shifts per day is optional: without it the report only counts.
handover.no_children: No children in the department now.
handover.watch_ph: Watch for… (optional — only for the child who needs it)
handover.unit_note_ph: Broken equipment, a closed bed, something short… (optional)
handover.handed: Handed over — waiting for the other side to accept.
handover.synthesis: I summarised what I heard and the giver confirmed it
handover.synthesis_done: The receiver summarised what they heard (I-PASS).
handover.waiting_for_other: You handed this over — someone else accepts it.
handover.critical_unseen: Critical result the doctor has not read
handover.report_sub: How many handovers, how many accepted, time to acceptance, and questions — per department and kind.
handover.short_title: Days with fewer handovers than shifts
handover.short_no_number: The hospital has not written a number of shifts, so nothing is judged — only counted.
handover.short_none: Every day had a handover for every shift.
handover.report_waiting_none: Every handover in the period was accepted.
handover.err_who: You need to be signed in.
handover.err_already_open: This department has a handover nobody has accepted yet.
handover.err_need_severity: I-PASS: choose the illness severity for every child.
handover.err_not_yours: Only whoever handed it over can withdraw it.
handover.err_own_question: Whoever handed over does not ask themselves.
handover.err_own_answer: Whoever asked does not answer themselves.
handover.err_own_handover: Whoever handed over cannot accept it themselves.
handover.err_wrong_discipline: Doctors' handovers are accepted by a doctor, nursing handovers by a nurse.
handover.err_need_synthesis: I-PASS: summarise what you heard first.
